dataset.description:
This dataset contains experimental data collected during pilot trials of the IMPROVED container-based water treatment systems. The trials were conducted across various sites and time periods, testing combinations of advanced treatment technologies for different water sources.

 The water treatment combined some of the following technologies:

  • EDR – Electrodialysis Reversal
  • GAC – Granular Activated Carbon
  • IEX – Ion Exchange
  • MD – Membrane Distillation
  • MIX – Mixed Bed Resin
  • RO – Reverse Osmosis
  • UF – Ultrafiltration

Further details on the trials and a detailed description of the IMPROVED pilot plant can be found at:  https://doi.org/10.1016/j.jenvman.2024.121949

The dataset consists of the following elements:

  • IMPROVED Containers data_AUTONOMOUS.docx: Document describing the variables for the data set collected during the autonomous control trial period.
  • IMPROVED Containers data_[EDR|GAC|MIX|RO|UF|IEX].docx: Document describing the variables of the dataset collected during the manual operation of the IMPROVED container.
  • [edr|gac|iex|md|mix|ro|uf].csv: The readings collected during the manual operation of the IMPROVED container.
  • AquaSPICE_logbook_Dow_Bohlen.xlsx, AquaSPICE_logbook_Dow_CTBD.xlsx, AquaSPICE_logbook_Dow_Terneuzen_DSBD.xlsx : Logbooks of the manual operation of the IMPROVED container on different locations.

 

 

Following, details on the various trials are provided:

 

 

---------------------------------------------

Subcase #1A – DBBV Terneuzen, Netherlands

Period: July 26, 2021 – November 12, 2021

Location: DBBV, Terneuzen
Focus: Power & Utilities sector – Cooling Tower Blowdown (CTBD) treatment

Technologies tested in the IMPROVED containers:

  • Coagulation
  • Flocculation
  • Lamella settler
  • Biologically Activated Carbon Filtration (BACF)
  • Ultrafiltration (UF)
  • Reverse Osmosis (RO)
  • Electrodialysis Reversal (EDR)

Note: Additional EDR testing was conducted at the REDstack pilot facility in Afsluitdijk, Netherlands, using feedwater transported from the DBBV Terneuzen site.

Logbook: AquaSPICE_logbook_Dow_CTBD.xlsx

Dataset: [edr|gac|iex|md|mix|ro|uf].csv: The readings collected during the manual operation of the IMPROVED container. (Limited to the before mentioned time period)

Dataset description: Containers data_[EDR|GAC|MIX|RO|UF|IEX].docx

-------

Period: October 20, 2022 – November 25, 2022

Location: DBBV Cracker Site, Dilution Steam Blowdown treatment

Technologies tested in various combinations:

  • Scavenger resins
  • Ion exchange resins
  • Membrane Aerated Biofilm Reactor (MABR)
  • Ultrafiltration (UF)
  • Reverse Osmosis (RO)
  • Lamella settler
  • Macroporous Polymer Extraction (MPPE)
  • Granular Activated Carbon (GAC)

Logbook: AquaSPICE_logbook_Dow_Terneuzen_DSBD.xlsx

Dataset: [edr|gac|iex|md|mix|ro|uf].csv: The readings collected during the manual operation of the IMPROVED container. (Limited to the before mentioned time period)

Dataset description: Containers data_[EDR|GAC|MIX|RO|UF|IEX].docx

---------------------------------------------

Subcase #1B – Dow Böhlen, Germany

Period: April 9, 2022 – August 16, 2022

Location: Near raw water and wastewater treatment plants on Dow premises

Water sources used:

  • Raw and pre-decarbonised water
  • Cooling tower blowdown (CTBD)

Technologies tested:

  • Biologically Activated Carbon Filtration (BACF)
  • Ion exchange resins
  • Scavenger resins
  • Ultrafiltration (UF)
  • Reverse Osmosis (RO)
  • Electrodialysis Reversal (EDR)

Logbook: AquaSPICE_logbook_Dow_Bohlen.xlsx

Dataset: [edr|gac|iex|md|mix|ro|uf].csv: The readings collected during the manual operation of the IMPROVED container. (Limited to the before mentioned time period)

Dataset description: Containers data_[EDR|GAC|MIX|RO|UF|IEX].docx

-------

Period: November 2024 – March 2025

Location: Effluent stream from Dow’s industrial WWTP

Focus of this phase:

  • Tests of the critical flux optimisation sequence. Every four hours, the system performs a critical flux evaluation by testing increasing flux values and recording permeability. The point of the first significant permeability drop defines the critical flux. Based on this, the optimal filtration rate and time are calculated (within set limits) and sent from the container to WaterCPS.

Dataset: critical_flux_control.csv

Dataset description: IMPROVED Containers data_AUTONOMOUS.docx

-------

Period: March 2025 – April 2025

Location: Effluent stream from Dow’s industrial WWTP

Focus of this phase:

  • Tests of the dynamic recovery rate control through hardness monitoring. This intelligent hardness-recovery control loop that continuously monitored the hardness levels in the RO permeate stream, automatically adjusted system recovery rates to maintain optimal water quality standards. Unlike conventional static operational approaches, this implementation enabled dynamic system response to varying feed water conditions and membrane performance characteristics, ensuring consistent product water quality while maximizing system efficiency.

Dataset: recovery_rate_control.csv

Dataset description: IMPROVED Containers data_AUTONOMOUS.docx

dataset.description:
This dataset relates to the testing of a wastewater treatment pilot plant implemented by AquaSPICE to assess the performance of bioreactors, biomembranes, and UV reactor in treating wastewater from the poultry industry. The plant was installed at the slaughterhouse of Agricola SA, one of Romania’s leading poultry meat producers, with a daily output exceeding 150 tonnes. The pilot plant received influent directly from the slaughterhouse.

The setup, illustrated in pilot_plant_diagram.png, consists of two main components: the water treatment pilot plant and a BactoSense unit. The BactoSense unit enables continuous measurement of various microbial parameters. A detailed schematic of the treatment system, including sensor locations, is provided in PID.png.

The dataset contains the following data files:

pilot_plant_data.xlsx: Contains the readings from the pilot plant. The columns of the file are:

Date / Time: Timestamp of the recorded data.

Flow at Start of Filtration [L/h]: Flow rate at the beginning of the filtration cycle.

Flow at End of Filtration [L/h]: Flow rate at the end of the filtration cycle.

Pressure at Start of Filtration [bar]: System pressure at the beginning of the filtration cycle.

Pressure at End of Filtration [bar]: System pressure at the end of the filtration cycle.

LT-7226 [m]: Liquid level measurement from sensor LT-7226, in meters.

LT-3426 [m]: Liquid level measurement from sensor LT-3426, in meters.

FT-3520 [L/h]: Flow rate from sensor FT-3520.

PT-3526 [bar]: Pressure reading from sensor PT-3526.

AIT-3432-pH [pH]: pH level measured by sensor AIT-3432.

TT-3430-Temp [°C]: Temperature measured by sensor TT-3430.

AIT-7538-Oxygen [mg/L]: Dissolved oxygen level from sensor AIT-7538.

AIT-7538-Temp [°C]: Temperature at the oxygen sensor location (AIT-7538).

Flow-P76 – Feed Flow Rate [L/h]: Flow rate of the feed stream to the system.

Flow-P73A [L/h]: Flow rate from stream P73A.

Flow-P73B [L/h]: Flow rate from stream P73B.

Flow-P38 [L/h]: Flow rate from stream P38.

Flow-FV3560 [L/h]: Flow rate through valve FV3560.

AIT-101-Temp [°C]: Temperature reading from sensor AIT-101.

AIT-101-pH [pH]: pH level from sensor AIT-101.

AIT-110-Conductivity [µS]: Electrical conductivity measured by sensor AIT-110, in microsiemens.

bactosense_data.csv: contains the readings from the bactosense device. The columns of the file are:

time_index: Timestamp of the measurement in UTC format.

Mode: Sampling method —

  • manual: Manually collected sample
  • automatic: Automatically collected sample from membrane outlet

Point: Sampling location —

  • P-uv: Before UV treatment
  • P+uv: After UV treatment

TCC: Total Cell Count — Total number of microbial cells detected

ICC: Intact Cell Count — Number of live, intact microbial cells

DCC: Dead Cell Count — Number of non-intact (dead) microbial cells

LNAC: Low Nucleic Acid Content — Cells with low DNA/RNA content

HNAP: High Nucleic Acid Population — Group of cells with high nucleic acid concentration

HNAC: High Nucleic Acid Content — Cells with elevated levels of DNA/RNA

dataset.description:
The dataset contains hourly averaged samples of water conductivity, temperature and depth from 18 measurement stations distributed across the Alberta Canal and Antwer Harbor area. 

- conductivity EC25    µS/cm    specific electrical conductivity of the water at reference temperature of 25°C measured at the depth position of the sensor - proxy for salinity
- water temperature    °C    water temperature measured at the depth position of the sensor
- water depth    mm    relative water depth (depended on sensor position) - height of the water column above the sensor derived from pressure measurement 

The included files contain:

  • AquaSpice_CS3_AntwerpHarbor_Sensors_Conductivity.xlsx: Conductivity readings
  • AquaSpice_CS3_AntwerpHarbor_Sensors_Depth.csv: Depth readings
  • AquaSpice_CS3_AntwerpHarbor_Sensors_Temperature.csv: Temperature readings.
  • AquaSpice_CS3_AntwerpHarbor_Sensors_Locations.csv: Latitude/Longitude of the measurement stations
dataset.title: Monitoring Salinization in the Alberta Canal and Antwerp Harbor

dataset.description:
This dataset originates from the WAPEREUSE pilot system, developed to treat industrial wastewater from the peroxide production unit at the Solvay plant in Rosignano Marittimo (Italy). The core treatment technology is a membrane bioreactor (MBR) operating under intermittent aeration.

The data includes sensor readings from two experimental phases:

·         Falconara Marittima (Ancona): December 2023 – June 2024

·         Rosignano Marittimo (Solvay site): February 2025 – May 2025 

The experimental phase focused on enhancing the biological removal of chemical oxygen demand (COD) and nitrates, using glycerol as an external carbon source and sodium hydroxide (NaOH) for pH neutralization.

The following information is provided:

 

  • process diagram.png: Ilustration of the process diagram
  • CS2_AquaSPICE_final conference.pptx: AquaSPICE final conference presentation on CS#2. “Case Study - Italy: Water Treatment and Re-use in Peroxide Production Units”.
  • CS2_CPTM.pptx: Presentation about “Experimentation on the pilot plant in the industrial environment”.
  • CS2_data.csv: The dataset.
  • Dataset_description.txt: Description of the columns of the dataset.

dmp.description: Either we rethink how we use water or we threaten the availability. Even though there is overall enough water to meet the world’s growing needs, it is necessary to make changes in how water is used, managed and shared. The EU-funded AquaSPICE project will increase awareness in resource efficiency. It will also deliver compact solutions for industrial applications, including water treatment and reuse technologies, and closed-loop recycling practices. The project will also develop a cyber-physical-system controller including a system for real-time monitoring, assessment and optimisation of water use and reuse at different interconnected levels. The overall approach is based on the adaptation of technologies and practices – from a single industrial process to an entire industry.
